header.title: Writing and Poetry
header.lead: Writing is one of the places where I let precision meet vulnerability: ideas become lines, feelings become arguments, and personal experience becomes something shareable.

data.text: Under the pen name [b]Maxim10[/b], I published a set of poems on La Passion des Poemes, a francophone poetry community. The public portfolio lists 19 poems published between 2015 and 2018, across love poems, sad poems, humorous poems, other poems, short forms, and acrostics. I list the works here as an index, but I do not reproduce the poems themselves; readers should access them through the original platform.

rows: [Ma vie c'est Paris et pari est ma vie](https://www.lapassiondespoemes.com/?action=viewpost&ID=5749&cat=7)

items: [b]Love and tenderness[/b]: several poems speak from intimate attachment, gratitude, admiration, or emotional vulnerability.
[b]Family and belonging[/b]: titles such as [i]Papa[/i], [i]Maman[/i], and [i]Pour mes frères[/i] show writing as a way to honor relationships.
[b]Social feeling[/b]: [i]Risque et solidarité[/i] and [i]L'hymne à la communauté[/i] place individual emotion inside a collective horizon.
[b]Melancholy and endurance[/b]: the sad-poem category carries the struggle to remain standing when life becomes heavy.
[b]Playfulness[/b]: humorous poems keep the archive from becoming only solemn; language is also a space for games and surprise.

data.text: My writing is not limited to poetry. Public records also preserve older computer-science tutorials and courses: Java pagination, MVC application design, and producing Windows executables from JAR files. This continuity matters to me: poetry and technical writing are different forms of transmission, but both require structure, audience awareness, and care for clarity.
